meaning: Luck, or a lot of money.
example: Go out into the world and find your fortune.

meaning: Wet earth.
example: The little pigs played in the mud.

meaning: Dry yellow stems of plants.
example: He built a house of straw.

meaning: Many things tied together.
example: He had a bundle of straw.

meaning: Thin pieces of wood from trees.
example: The second pig built a house of sticks.

meaning: A hard red block for building walls.
example: The third pig built a house of bricks.

meaning: A wild animal like a big dog.
example: A big grey wolf knocked at the door.

meaning: Wanting food.
example: The wolf was very hungry.

meaning: A thin opening.
example: He looked through a crack in the door.

meaning: To breathe out strongly.
example: I will huff and I will puff.

meaning: To blow air out in short breaths.
example: He huffed and he puffed.

meaning: To make something fall by blowing.
example: He could not blow the house down.

meaning: A funny way to say chin, in the old rhyme.

meaning: Wooden covers for a window.

meaning: A tube that takes smoke out of a house.

meaning: The place in a room where you make a fire.
example: There was a big fireplace in the kitchen.

meaning: A round white vegetable that grows in the ground.
example: He pulled up a big pile of turnips.

meaning: A large open area of grass.
example: The turnip field was far away.

meaning: A tree that gives apples.
example: They went to the apple tree.

meaning: A container made of thin sticks.
example: He took a basket to the field.

meaning: To go up with your hands and feet.
example: He had to climb the tree.

meaning: A place with many stalls, games and food.
example: There is a fair in the town.

meaning: A small shop at a fair.
example: He looked at all the stalls.

meaning: A wooden barrel used to make butter.
example: He bought a fine wooden butter churn.

meaning: A round wooden container.
example: It was a big wooden barrel.

meaning: To turn over and over.
example: The churn began to roll down the hill.

meaning: Very bad.
example: I saw a terrible thing.

meaning: A big frightening creature.
example: It was a great round monster.

meaning: A deep round container for cooking.
example: He put a big pot of water on the fire.

meaning: To heat water until it bubbles.
example: The water began to boil.

meaning: The cloud that rises from hot water.
example: Steam rose from the pot.

meaning: The cover of a pot.

meaning: The sound of water when something falls in.

meaning: Flat pieces that cover a roof.
example: He stood on the tiles.

meaning: To move smoothly down a surface.
example: He began to slide.

meaning: Quick to understand or find good ideas.
example: He was a clever little pig.

meaning: Not in danger.
example: I will be safe in a strong house.

meaning: Strong and not moving.
example: The walls stood as firm as a rock.

meaning: To make someone believe something false.
example: I will trick him another way.

meaning: To go fast.
example: The third pig was not in a hurry.

meaning: Hurting a little.
example: His hands were sore.

meaning: Happy about something you did.
example: He felt very proud.

meaning: Too sweet and kind, but not true.

meaning: To make short sounds by shaking.

meaning: Feeling that everything turns.
example: He blew until he was dizzy.

meaning: The soft hair of an animal.
example: He brushed the dust from his fur.

meaning: A person who is not clever.

meaning: The white hard parts in your mouth.
example: The wolf had long sharp teeth.
